BiblicalUsage: The word is an error, an oversight, and it appears once, when Jacob sends his sons back to Egypt with double money: the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again, peradventure it was an oversight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the oversight is the test: Jacob would rather overpay than be found keeping what was not his, and honesty is the first step home.
